mapper.select: SELECT g.user_id AS userId, g.app_id AS appId, a.name AS appName, p.name AS policyName, mo.override_type AS overrideType, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tab_app_access_policy_browser_rule br WHERE br.policy_id = g.policy_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tab_app_access_policy_ip_rule ir WHERE ir.policy_id = g.policy_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS hasRequestControl FROM tab_app_access_policy_grant g INNER JOIN tab_app_access_policy p ON p.id = g.policy_id AND p.status = 2000 INNER JOIN tab_app a ON a.id = g.app_id LEFT JOIN tab_app_access_manual_override mo ON mo.user_id = g.user_id AND mo.app_id = g.app_id WHERE g.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT mo.user_id AS userId, mo.app_id AS appId, a.name AS appName, mo.override_type AS overrideType FROM tab_app_access_manual_override mo INNER JOIN tab_app a ON a.id = mo.app_id WHERE mo.user_id = #{userId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tab_app_access_policy_grant g2 INNER JOIN tab_app_access_policy p2 ON p2.id = g2.policy_id AND p2.status = 2000 WHERE g2.user_id = mo.user_id AND g2.app_id = mo.app_id )

SELECT g.user_id AS userId, u.name AS userName, g.app_id AS appId, p.name AS policyName, mo.override_type AS overrideType, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tab_app_access_policy_browser_rule br WHERE br.policy_id = g.policy_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tab_app_access_policy_ip_rule ir WHERE ir.policy_id = g.policy_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS hasRequestControl FROM tab_app_access_policy_grant g INNER JOIN tab_app_access_policy p ON p.id = g.policy_id AND p.status = 2000 INNER JOIN tab_user u ON u.id = g.user_id LEFT JOIN tab_app_access_manual_override mo ON mo.user_id = g.user_id AND mo.app_id = g.app_id WHERE g.app_id = #{appId}

SELECT mo.user_id AS userId, u.name AS userName, mo.app_id AS appId, mo.override_type AS overrideType FROM tab_app_access_manual_override mo INNER JOIN tab_user u ON u.id = mo.user_id WHERE mo.app_id = #{appId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tab_app_access_policy_grant g2 INNER JOIN tab_app_access_policy p2 ON p2.id = g2.policy_id AND p2.status = 2000 WHERE g2.user_id = mo.user_id AND g2.app_id = mo.app_id )
